shadows.style: soft layered navy shadows with restrained AI glow

must: Maintain 48dp touch targets and WCAG AA contrast
Keep onboarding, auth, shell, and dashboard visually continuous
Preserve Flutter Riverpod and GoRouter architecture
avoid: Mixed icon families within a component group
Decorative glass, gradients, or motion without hierarchy purpose
Presentation changes that alter authentication business logic

decisions.choice: Cinematic navy topographic brand fields paired with calm light or dark work surfaces
decisions.reason: Creates continuity between onboarding and the authenticated dashboard

decisions.choice: Story-led onboarding and focused single-task auth cards with contextual side narratives on wider layouts
decisions.reason: Preserves mobile clarity while giving larger screens an intentional composition

decisions.choice: Flat five-item footer with compact single-line labels and no overlapping center action
decisions.reason: Protects icon rhythm, touch clarity, and scanability on narrow mobile widths
